rationale: vendor_ip is attributed black_box, so u_ip is unmodeled (CST-005 WARNING Unresolved) and resp_q captures its output (CDC-023 WARNING Unresolved). The macro's internal domains and output timing are unknown.

author_reading.rationale: Output of an unmodeled (* black_box *) vendor submodule is captured by a clk_io register: behaviour and domain of the box are unanalyzed.

labels.rationale: An attributed black box drives ip_resp and resp_q captures it. The shared interface clock cannot establish which domain launches the opaque macro response.

Instance u_ip of module vendor_ip is marked (* black_box *) (design.sv:2-3, 22) with no library model supplied (CST-005 WARNING Unresolved), and its output ip_resp is captured by register resp_q on posedge clk_io (design.sv:26), leaving the internal launch domain and CDC safety of the black-box output path unresolved (CDC-023 WARNING Unresolved).
